attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 9, `yiiM` to `rhaM`, are carried by 92 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 9% of calls. The model names 11 to 100% of them, fewest at column 4, `rhaR`, 11%.

**A fork and variable stretch follows at `frvA`**, columns 10 to 14, carried by 69 to 79%, in a region of plasticity in 70 to 80% of calls. The `rha` genes, columns 3 to 9, are [[l-rhamnose catabolism]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 95 against 91%, and hesitates less there, 0.16 against 0.34 bits. It hesitates most at column 10, `frvA`, a fork column, 0.75 bits.

**The window ends on fork columns.** Columns 72 to 79, `udp` to `rhtB`, are carried by 44 to 89% of chromosomes, all persistent. The last column is `rhtB`, in 44% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 94% of genes**, 0.22 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.50 against 0.13 bits, and names fewer genes, 87% against 96%.

label: yiiM
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yiiM window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yiiM, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,220 to 4,299 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yiiM once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.22 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 31,959 calls, named 97%, 0.11 bits; shell 11,129 calls, named 86%, 0.51 bits; cloud 112 calls, named 16%, 2.07 bits. Outside an RGP 33,015 calls, named 96%, 0.13 bits; inside an RGP 10,185 calls, named 87%, 0.50 bits. Columns: 53 spine, 17 fork, 10 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.50 against 0.13 bits) and names fewer genes (87% against 96%); 10,185 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 10 (frvA, a fork column) 0.75 bits, RGP 79%; column 1 (kdgT, a spine column) 0.66 bits, RGP 0%; column 35 (ompL, a variable column) 0.59 bits, RGP 77%. The 18 columns (columns 10-14 and 26-38) where most calls are in an RGP: named 89%, 0.43 bits on average; the other 62 columns: named 95%, 0.16 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 53 spine columns: named 95%, 0.16 bits on average; the 27 fork and variable columns: named 91%, 0.34 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 10, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 26-38 (fork and variable columns), RGP 55-89%; the least: columns 0-9 (spine), RGP 0-9%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-9 (10 columns) spine: share 92-100%, all P, RGP 0-9%. Genes: yiiM "6-hydroxyaminopurine reductase", kdgT, sodA, rhaT "L-rhamnose/proton symporter RhaT", rhaR, rhaS, rhaB, rhaA, rhaD, rhaM. named 11-100% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 4 (rhaR), named 11%; most hesitant at column 1 (kdgT), 0.66 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 10-14 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: share 69-79%, all S, RGP 70-80%. named 81-98% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 10, named 81%, 0.75 bits.
[S2.c10]    10 fork: frvA S 78%; also "carbohydrate porin" S 48%, "IS1 family transposase" S 24%

[S3] 3. columns 15-19 (5 columns) spine: share 98%, all P, RGP 3-27%. Genes: fdhD, fdnG, fdoH, fdoI "formate dehydrogenase cytochrome b5…", fdhE. named 93-99% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 15 (fdhD), named 93%, 0.34 bits.
[S4] 4. column 20 fork: share 83%, all S, RGP 8%. named 95%; 0.21 bits.
[S4.c20]    20: yiiF S 83% "protein YiiF"; also "alpha/beta hydrolase" S 21%

[S6] 6. columns 26-38 (13 columns) fork and variable columns: share 66-87%, all S, RGP 55-89%. named 82-96% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 33, named 82%; most hesitant at column 35, 0.59 bits.
